overview: Studying Information Technology in Finland prepares international students for careers across the global technology ecosystem. International students can choose from English-taught bachelor’s and master’s programmes across research universities and universities of applied sciences. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** helps students explore suitable IT programmes, compare universities and tuition fees, understand admission requirements, and prepare their applications for studying in Finland.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Information Technology in Finland in English?
faq.answer: Yes. Several Finnish research universities and universities of applied sciences offer English-taught IT-related programmes. Students must meet the academic, language and documentation requirements of their selected programme.

faq.question: What is the duration of an IT degree in Finland?
faq.answer: Bachelor’s programmes generally take three to four years, depending on the institution (180 to 240 ECTS). Research university master’s programmes typically take two years (120 ECTS). Combined bachelor’s and master’s pathways take five years in total.

faq.question: What are the tuition fees for Information Technology in Finland?
faq.answer: For the programmes listed here, annual tuition fees range from approximately €10,000 to €17,000 per year (around ₹10.86 lakh to ₹18.46 lakh). Selected universities offer early-bird discounts and merit scholarships.

faq.question: Can I apply for a master’s degree after completing a bachelor’s in IT?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants with a recognised bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant field can apply if they meet the selected master’s programme’s academic and language requirements.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help me study Information Technology in Finland?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help you explore suitable bachelor’s and master’s programmes, compare universities and tuition fees, understand eligibility requirements and prepare your application documents and residence permit application.
